# Moodle.org

> Moodle is an open-source learning platform providing plugins, extensions, and community resources for educators and developers to customize and enhance online learning experiences.

Moodle.org serves as the central hub for the Moodle community, offering access to thousands of plugins and extensions that extend the platform's core functionality. The site connects educators, developers, and institutions using Moodle's flexible learning management system.

## Key Topics

- Moodle plugins
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Plugin extensions
- Course activities
- Quiz
- Assignment
- Workshop
- SCORM
- LTI
- BigBlueButton
- Custom certificate
- Atto editor
- TinyMCE
- Version compatibility
- Moodle community

## Plugin Directory & Extensions

- [Moodle Plugins Directory](https://moodle.org/plugins/): Comprehensive directory of Moodle plugins and extensions for customizing learning platform functionality, including version compatibility and plugin categories.
